statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-33947 (GHSA-xwrw-4f8h-rjvg, https://github.com/jqlang/jq/security/advisories/GHSA-xwrw-4f8h-rjvg): in jq 1.8.1 and earlier, jv_setpath(), jv_getpath() and delpaths_sorted() in src/jv_aux.c recurse once per element of a caller-supplied path, so a path of about 65,000 elements exhausts the C stack and crashes jq. It is fixed by https://github.com/jqlang/jq/commit/fb59f1491058d58bdc3e8dd28f1773d1ac690a1f, first released in jq 1.8.2 (https://github.com/jqlang/jq/releases/tag/jq-1.8.2). Checked every jq package in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository for x86_64 and aarch64: 1.8.1-r0 is upstream jq 1.8.1 with Alpine's 3.23 patches, 1.8.1_git20260429-r1 is the same plus upstream commit e47e56d (the CVE-2026-32316 fix), and 1.8.2_git20260622-r1 and 1.8.2_git20261021-r2 are upstream jq 1.8.2, as the version string in /usr/bin/jq and libjq confirms. Every build before 1.8.2_git20260622-r1 is jq 1.8.1 without this fix, and every build from 1.8.2_git20260622-r1 on is jq 1.8.2, which contains it. The 'Path too deep' error the fix adds is in libjq of the 1.8.2 builds only.

CVE-2026-33947 (GHSA-xwrw-4f8h-rjvg, https://github.com/jqlang/jq/security/advisories/GHSA-xwrw-4f8h-rjvg): in jq 1.8.1 and earlier, jv_setpath(), jv_getpath() and delpaths_sorted() in src/jv_aux.c recurse once per element of a caller-supplied path, so a path of about 65,000 elements exhausts the C stack and crashes jq. It is fixed by https://github.com/jqlang/jq/commit/fb59f1491058d58bdc3e8dd28f1773d1ac690a1f, first released in jq 1.8.2 (https://github.com/jqlang/jq/releases/tag/jq-1.8.2). Checked every jq build in the DHI Debian 13 repository for amd64 and arm64, using the changelog each package ships and its libjq. Debian backported the fix in 1.7.1-6+deb13u2 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-33947), and builds before the first rebuild of 1.7.1-6+deb13u2 predate that backport. The repository also has a 1.8.1-5 build (arm64 only) whose changelog is an unreleased Debian 1.8.1-5 snapshot from January 2026 with no 2026 security fixes (the 1.8.1-5 that Debian later released to unstable carries the fix; this build does not), and a rebuild of Debian 1.8.2-1, which is upstream jq 1.8.2. The 'Path too deep' error the fix adds is present in libjq in the rebuilds of 1.7.1-6+deb13u2 and 1.8.2-1, and absent from the earlier builds and from the 1.8.1-5 build. The range therefore closes at the first 1.7.1-6+deb13u2 rebuild, reopens at 1.8.1-5 and closes again at the rebuild of 1.8.2-1.
